description: Source file containing functions to set up mock server expectations using OpenAPI specifications loaded from various sources (URL, file, classpath, JSON/YAML literals).

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Sets up an expectation using an OpenAPI spec loaded from a URL over HTTP.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Sets up expectations for specific operations and responses from an OpenAPI spec loaded from a URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Sets up an expectation using an OpenAPI spec loaded from a local file URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Sets up an expectation using an OpenAPI spec loaded from a classpath location.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonLiteral
methods.description: Sets up an expectation using an OpenAPI spec loaded from a JSON literal read from a file.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlLiteral
methods.description: Sets up an expectation using an OpenAPI spec loaded from a YAML literal.
